title: Chiang Mai · Mae Hong Son Loop Stage
slogan: A 334 km loop out of Mae Rim fuel
story: Thousands of bends, heat and a loop that deserves days. Out of Chiang Mai and back again: 334 km, roughly 6 h 25 in the saddle. It goes by way of Pai mountain road and Mae Hong Son. Doi Inthanon option is the high point. It tops out at about 1,050 m. The passes are the reason to go.
